results.title: Velozity
results.content:
Description: Velozity is an intelligence layer for individuals and teams. It starts with you, where voice becomes action within seconds, context never fades, and every call and screen is observed with consent, building a living memory that compounds every day. You can invite your friends, colleagues, or clients to scale this intelligence into a shared space for real-time collaboration and seamless execution. Before every call, Velozity delivers instant AI context to keep you fully prepared, while your on-call assistant joins as a proactive partner helping you in real time. We are redefining the modern workspace, where you and AI work as one, eliminating the friction between intention and execution, empowering you to operate at the speed of thought. A chat assistant can be enough for summaries. A teammate that touches real tools needs stronger boundaries.

This guide ranks the strongest options for teams evaluating multiplayer AI agents. Dash leads because it is built for approval-first work inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. The peer set covers assistant delegation, visual AI workflows, enterprise knowledge agents, Claude reasoning, broad app-action automation, and multiplayer AI workspaces.

In this article, we are going to cover: [...] ### 7. Dust

Best for: Teams that want a shared AI workspace for custom agents and company knowledge.

Dust is strongest when the team wants a shared AI workspace for people and custom agents. Dust describes its product as multiplayer AI for human-agent collaboration, and its pricing page lists Pro with monthly credits. That makes it a credible option for knowledge-heavy teams that want shared context and reusable agents.

Choose Dust over Dash when the center of work is a collaborative AI workspace. Choose Dash when the team wants a chat-native coworker that connects to tools and asks before it sends, posts, writes, or spends.
